scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "corepack pnpm --filter @research/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @research/web dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @research/domain build && corepack pnpm --filter @research/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @research/persistence build && corepack pnpm --filter @research/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @research/web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.build:shared: corepack pnpm --filter @research/domain build && corepack pnpm --filter @research/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @research/persistence build
scripts.account:create: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @research/api build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/create-account.ts
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @research/api build && node --import tsx --test packages/domain/test/integration/*.test.mjs packages/persistence/test/integration/*.test.mjs apps/api/test/integration/*.test.mjs && bash scripts/test/account-cli.sh
scripts.demo:seed: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @research/api build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/seed-demo.ts
